This implies a chain of interactions where Ludongnin G may act on the Werner syndrome helicase, potentially modulating its activity, and Macluraxanthone B may further influence Aconitate hydratase, mitochondrial. The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that Ludongnin G could be a modulator of Aconitate hydratase, mitochondrial through the Werner syndrome helicase pathway. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, but further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction and functional role of Ludongnin G in this pathway.
